## Activity

During October 2023, East City Eye Clinic completed 181 captures. Activity was maintained throughout the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading activity during the month. No additional operational issues were recorded in the information provided for this report.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for review. There were 4 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 2.2. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered when monitoring capture practice and identifying any need for local follow-up. The overall rate remains a key measure for routine site monitoring.

## Grading

Grading identified 54 referable results during October 2023. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This measure indicates the typical interval between image acquisition and completion of grading. Together, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide a concise account of service performance at East City Eye Clinic for the reporting month.
